task_context.problem_statement: James buys a jar of hot sauce.   Each serving is .5 ounces.  He uses 3 servings every day.  if the container is 2 ounces less than 1 quart how many days will it last?
task_context.reference_solution:
A quart is 32 ounces so this jar is 32-2=<<32-2=30>>30 ounces
James uses 3*.5=<<3*.5=1.5>>1.5 ounces a day
So it last 30/1.5=<<30/1.5=20>>20 day
#### 20
